# Taylor Success Enterprise

> Taylor Success Enterprise is a full-service media, branding and public relations agency headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, led by award-winning publicist, event producer and brand strategist Taylor Frucel (also known as Taylor Stubbs Frucel). Taylor is also leading the Resource Center, a proposed community coworking, learning and event space in Atlanta that is seeking $150,000 in funding and partners.

## Key facts
- Founder: Taylor Frucel, publicist, entrepreneur, event producer, brand strategist, businesswoman and talent liaison. 15+ years of experience in marketing, public relations, real estate, business development and brand growth. 5-time award-winning publicist.
- Events: 45+ produced in Atlanta, 220+ coordinated nationwide, including World Cup events, youth activations, community giveaways and nonprofit initiatives.
- Featured on: BET, MTV, Tubi, NBC and other platforms. Provided public relations and marketing support for Invest Fest. Connected to 280+ blogs and media outlets.
- Tagline: "My passion is business, and my purpose is people." (Business. People. Impact.)
- Contact: (443) 347-3239 | tsenterprisesatlanta@gmail.com | Instagram @iamtaylorfrucel
- Location: Atlanta, Georgia, USA. Serves Atlanta, nationwide and international clients.

## Resource Center (funding opportunity)
- A proposed community resource and event center in Atlanta: coworking and business services, event and venue space, community and professional development, a library and learning center, and media and technology access.
- Funding sought: $150,000 to establish the Atlanta flagship (facility and furnishings, technology and equipment, learning and programming, launch and working capital).
- Planning targets: $300,000 (year 1), $480,000 (year 2), $690,000 (year 3) in revenue.
- Get involved: funding, sponsorship and partnership inquiries, or early interest in using the space, via the contact page.

## Agency services
- Public relations and media: press write-ups, media pitching, blog placements, interviews, red carpet coverage, radio and podcast appearances
- Event production and management
- Branding and marketing campaigns: social media growth, EPK development
- Sponsorships and partnerships
- Talent and entertainment relations
- Business development and consulting, including leadership coaching
